name: Earth connection
summary: An earth connection identifies a documented circuit connection to earth.
description: An earth connection identifies a documented circuit connection to earth. The drawing's label and context establish whether it serves system earthing, protection or another specified role.
readingNotes: Read the connection's purpose instead of treating every earth mark as interchangeable.
